tools.name: web_search_exa
tools.description: Search the web for any topic and get clean, ready-to-use content. Best for: Finding current information, news, facts, people, companies, or answering questions about any topic. Returns: Clean text content from top search results. Query tips: describe the ideal page, not keywords. "blog post comparing React and Vue performance" not "React vs Vue". Use category:people / category:company to search through Linkedin profiles / companies respectively. If highlights are insufficient, follow up with web

params.name: query
params.description: Natural language search query. Should be a semantically rich description of the ideal page, not just keywords. Optionally include category:<type> (company, people) to focus results — e.g. 'category:pe

params.name: numResults
params.description: Number of search results to return (default: 10).

tools.name: web_fetch_exa
tools.description: Read a webpage's full content as clean markdown. Use after web_search_exa when highlights are insufficient or to read any URL. Best for: Extracting full content from known URLs. Batch multiple URLs in one call. Returns: Clean text content and metadata from the page(s).

params.name: urls
params.description: URLs to read. Batch multiple URLs in one call.

params.name: maxCharacters
params.description: Maximum characters to extract per page (default: 3000)

prompts.name: web_search_help
prompts.description: Get help with web search using Exa

resources.name: tools_list
resources.description: List of available Exa tools and their descriptions
